PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <urn:ref:>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?ahu ?zone ?tempPoint ?series WHERE {
  ?ahu a brick:AirHandlingUnit ; rdfs:label "AHU02" .
  ?ahu brick:feeds ?zone .
  ?tempPoint a brick:Air_Temperature_Sensor ; brick:hasLocation ?zone .
  ?tempPoint ref:hasTimeseriesId ?series .
}

input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
SELECT ?s ?cls ?loc WHERE {
  ?s a ?cls .
  FILTER (regex(str(?cls),"Temperature_Sensor"))
  ?s brick:hasLocation ?loc .
  FILTER (regex(str(?loc),"VAV_F2_Z0|Zone|Z0"))
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
SELECT ?s ?cls ?loc WHERE {
  ?s a ?cls .
  FILTER (regex(str(?cls),"_Temperature_Sensor","i"))
  ?s brick:hasLocation ?loc .
  FILTER (regex(str(?loc),"Zone_F2","i") || regex(str(?loc),"F2_Z0","i"))
}

SELECT ?zone ?sensor ?series WHERE {
  ?sensor a ?cls ; brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  FILTER (regex(str(?zone),"Zone_F2_","i"))
  FILTER (regex(str(?cls),"Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor","i"))
  ?sensor ref:hasExternalReference/[] ?ign .
  ?sensor ?p ?series .
  FILTER (regex(str(?p),"hasExternalReference","i") AND regex(str(?series),"tsref","i"))
}
